summary.name: Motion
summary.one_liner: Motion is an AI-powered productivity platform that combines task management, project management, calendar scheduling, meeting notes, docs, and search in one app.
use_cases: Automatically prioritizing and scheduling daily tasks
Generating project plans from a description
Taking meeting notes and assigning follow-up action items
Managing team capacity and project deadlines
Consolidating multiple calendars to avoid double-booking
summary.what_it_does:
Motion uses AI to prioritize tasks and projects based on deadlines, priorities, dependencies and durations, then timeblocks them on a calendar that it reschedules automatically as plans change. Its AI Project Manager can generate projects with tasks, deadlines and assignees from a written description and attached docs, and it tracks statuses and flags delays. The AI Meeting Notetaker records and transcribes meetings, produces summaries and action items, and can email follow-ups to attendees. Motion also includes an AI docs editor, cross-app search, a workflow builder that turns SOPs into project templates, and team dashboards for capacity and project ETA prediction. The page says it connects with Google Meet, Gmail, Outlook, Siri, HubSpot and Salesforce, and offers a public API.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
